# Audit: `content/intersubjective-truth.md` (4,758 words)

## 1. Argument

**Thesis (mine):** Some truths (money, law, nations) are generated by agreement rather than by the world. Because the pipeline reaches into heads, passing such a truth along is part of making it, so the truth-regimes, capture, correction, and speed all change: agreements converge, split, or hollow out instead of being preserved, inverted, or ignored; capture means steering whose decodes count; there is no corrective, only the fork; and cheap transport removed the inertia that used to steady large agreements.

**Does it earn it?** Yes, and it is the only one of the seven written at chapter grade: an opening experiment (L13–19), worked examples throughout (founding stories, astrology, the dollar, hyperinflation, the Reformation, Ethereum, SVB), and a real second thesis (L87). Where it sags: L27 (astrology) is a detour the note itself flags as insecure (L111); L63 (~330 words) and L65 (~300 words) are each two paragraphs wearing one coat; L93 is a 260-word bold paragraph restating the entire note; L97–107 "What this changes" is ~800 words, and every bullet is already restated by its chapter (Ch 2 links this note six times, `case-studies-and-three-realities.md:112–156`; 5c:87; 9:146; 10:71; 11:101; 12:37).

**Depends on terms the reader doesn't have:** *5c's three regimes* (L47; fine if placed after 5c), *consumer-key / surface capture* (L61–63; home is the taxonomy, which has no place in the reading order), *the dilution loop* (L51; home is the myths note, same problem), *credible neutrality* (L107), *the Hammer* (L73).

**Single most valuable change:** cut L91–107 to the one sentence at L95 ("for objective content the captured pipeline distorts the truth; for intersubjective content it *decides* it"), split L63 and L65, and give the note a numbered slot. The second blade (L87) is a thesis-level claim and cannot live in an appendix. See the structure file.

## 2. Voice

**(a) Self-narration.** "Chapter N" ×27, "the book" ×19, "this note/the note" ×11, "this chapter/the chapter" ×6. Worst 8: L7 (the entire opening paragraph is bookkeeping: "pays a debt three chapters have flagged by name … admitted … confessed … scoped … called the missing work"); L9 "One commitment up front, because it disciplines everything after it"; L27 "(This carving is doing load-bearing work and is not yet fully secure; the uncertainties section comes back to it.)"; L51 "this note adds only the reframe that the myth note was too transmission-flavored to state"; L55 "The uncertainties section carries it."; L87 "the book has so far only said one"; L89 "Plainly, to come up for air:"; L93 "The note, said whole:"; L95 "The sentence the rest of the book should inherit".

**(b) Reversals (~20, the most of the seven).** Worst 6: L35 "The pipeline does not report the agreement; it is one of the places the agreement happens"; L43 "you have not gotten the truth wrong; **you have manufactured a different truth**"; L63 "The trained key is not reading equipment pointed at the reality. **The trained key is a share of the reality.**"; L75 "A fork does not determine which side was correct. **A fork determines how many truths there are now.**"; L77 "Whatever wins the gates does not approximate the truth better or worse. **It becomes the truth.**"; L89 "it is not that shared realities never collapsed before. It is that they used to collapse at the speed of rumor, and now…". Several of these are the note's best lines; the problem is frequency, not any one instance.

**(c) Triads / cascades / parentheticals.** L65 "'Money just *is* valuable.' 'The market decided.' 'The law is the law.'"; L61 "the issuer, the court, the platform's trending panel"; L71 then L93 "renegotiated, abandoned, or forked" / "schism, secession, dollarization, chain split"; L85 "deliberation, committees, announcements timed to morning papers"; L93 nested colons four deep.

**(d) Tics.** exactly ×7 (highest), honest ×5 (L55, L75, L111, L113, L114), load-bearing ×3, quietly ×3 (L53, L75, L107), "does real work" ×1 (L47), sharpen ×2, precisely ×2.

**(e) Aphorisms.** L19 "One had a generator the network can't reach. The other *is* the network's reach."; L37 "the camera is part of the crime scene."; L53 "The words outlive the truth."; L75 "the designers knew there would be no referee, so they built the exit."; L87 "A stabilizer that responds slower than the thing it stabilizes is really just a spectator with a title." Plus L89, which announces its own plain restatement ("Plainly, to come up for air:"); keep the sentence, cut the announcement.

**(f) Uncertainty section (L109–115, ~640 words).** All five bullets are genuine and specific; this is the best-argued uncertainties section in the set. Bullet 5 (literature unengaged) is now half-stale: Searle, Berger & Luckmann, Anderson, Hacking, Soros, and Hirschman are all in `data/sources.json` with citation pages, each marked "not yet engaged." Link them from the bullet and from the body where each applies. Trim bullet 1 by 40%.

**Rewrites.**

*L7 (original, ~200 words):* "Working note. This one pays a debt three chapters have flagged by name…"
*Rewrite (60 words):* "Chapter 2 introduced Harari's three realities and admitted its treatment of the third was a sketch. Chapter 5c built the book's truth machinery for claims that have a fact behind them. This is the other case: claims whose truth is made by the agreeing. It asks what the pipeline does to a truth when carrying it is part of making it."

*L35–37 (original, ~180 words):* "For an intersubjective claim, the separation does not exist … Pointing it somewhere *makes things happen there*."
*Rewrite (80 words):* "For an intersubjective claim there is no outside. The truth is the agreement; the agreement lives in heads; the pipeline is what reaches into heads at scale. Someone decoding 'the dollar is sound' isn't reading about the agreement. Their decode is one more mind holding, or dropping, the thing whose being-held is the truth. **Passing an intersubjective truth along is part of making it.** With facts, the pipeline is a security camera. Here the camera is part of the crime scene."

*L63 (original, ~330 words):* "Run the taxonomy's main axis. *Surface capture* … re-train the readers and you have amended the constitution, not merely distorted its reception."
*Rewrite (120 words):* "The taxonomy's main split applies. Seizing the visible organs (the issuer, the court, the trending panel) steers the heavy votes directly. That is serious, and it is the recoverable kind: everyone can see where the organs are. Re-tuning the keys people decode with (curriculum, catechism, feed) is the slow disaster for objective content, because re-tuned readers misread even good evidence. For intersubjective content it is worse by a category. **A trained key is not equipment pointed at the reality; it is a share of it.** Capture a curriculum about the world and you get readers who are wrong; the world waits to correct them. Capture a curriculum about the nation and the readers' agreement *generates* the captor's nation. Nothing is waiting."

*L93 (original, ~260-word bold paragraph):* "The note, said whole: **intersubjective truths are truths … against institutions built for committee speed.**"
*Rewrite (cut to L95, 40 words):* "One sentence to carry forward. For objective content, a captured pipeline distorts the truth. For intersubjective content, a captured pipeline *decides* it. That is why Chapter 2 called this the scarier failure, and why the prescriptive chapters can't treat it as a footnote."

**Frontmatter proposal:**
```yaml
description: "Money, law, and nations are true because enough people agree. This note works out what happens to that kind of truth in a pipeline that reaches into everyone's heads: spreading it is part of making it, it can't be corrected only forked, and it now moves faster than the institutions that steady it."
aliases: [intersubjective truth, Harari three realities, truth from agreement, constitutive truth, reification, the fork, bank run self-fulfilling, hollow constitution, why money is real, meme speed vs committee speed]
```

## 6. Reader-facing defects

- "Constitution" is used in two senses (the act of constituting; a country's founding document) within a few lines (L51, L71 "A constitution cannot be falsified"). A general reader will read L71 as being about the U.S. Constitution. Pick "constituting/constituted" for the act.
- L81 attributes the transport-collapse claim to "[[the-information-landscape|Chapter 1]]" — Ch 1 doesn't make it; `transport-vs-selection.md:55` does. ⚠ Misattribution.
- L7 quotes three chapters' self-confessions; a reader who hasn't read them can't parse the paragraph.
- L29 "chain explorers," L75 "block-size question": crypto jargon, one clause each.
- L61–63 use "surface capture" / "consumer-key capture" cold; the taxonomy has no reading-order position.
- L115 "The philosophical literature is unengaged" is contradicted by `data/sources.json`, which lists all six with stances; the note should say "listed, not yet read into the argument."
- Ch 9 (`integration-problem.md:146,182`) says the chapter-grade treatment "remains future work"; consistent, but if this note becomes a chapter that line must change.

## Top 5 actions

1. Cut L91–107 to the L95 sentence; the chapters have absorbed the rest.
2. Split L63 and L65; reduce bolds from fourteen to five.
3. Link the six social-ontology sources at the lines where each applies, and fix bullet 5 to match sources.json.
4. Fix the L81 misattribution and the two-sense "constitution."
5. Give it a numbered slot (see structure file); it is the book's second thesis and is written to chapter standard already.
